name: Ten-Word VC-Saturated Witness
properties: It has VC dimension two, is VC-saturated and shattering-saturated, and is neither ample nor maximum. Its last-coordinate one-section is not shattering-saturated. Its one-inclusion graph is not isometric: $1011$ and $1101$ have Hamming distance two but graph distance four, so it is not a partial cube in the displayed embedding.
